zh-CN.intro: 0.1.5 增加了图片与视频模型接入、可选的输入建议和飞书群任务分流，并补齐任务状态、模型发现、远端恢复以及多个桌面与手机端细节。iOS 和 Android 都可直接获得内容更新；已经安装 0.1.4 的用户无需重新安装，iOS 也不需要新的 TestFlight 构建。

topics.title: 图片和视频模型进入统一入口
topics.text: 连接的模型服务提供 xAI 图片或视频模型时，Mira 现在可以发现并使用这些能力，包括 Grok Imagine Video。插件的媒体工具也会从同一份模型目录寻找可用能力；实际可用范围取决于你连接的服务和模型。

topics.title: 输入建议可以先填再改
topics.text: 输入框可以显示一条可选的推荐提示，帮助你从空白处开始。这个功能默认关闭；开启后按 Tab 只会把建议填入输入框，不会直接发送，你仍可继续修改。

topics.title: 飞书群里的问题自动分到独立话题
topics.text: 在飞书群主会话里 @ Mira 时，会自动开启话题，每个话题保持为独立任务，避免不同问题混在一起。如果无法创建话题，Mira 会留在原群聊中继续，不会中断回复。

topics.title: 任务状态和侧栏信息更完整
topics.text: 侧栏现在能更清楚地显示任务时间、关联的拉取请求、Token 与费用，并及时更新正在运行的任务优先级。搜索、长标题提示、Worker 布局、拉取请求与审查意见状态也更容易查看。

topics.title: 模型发现与路由更可靠
topics.text: Mira 会更准确地识别模型来自哪个服务、当前账号可以看到哪些模型，并为每个模型选择正确的调用方式。GLM 等服务也能补齐可用模型，切换账号、刷新目录或生成任务标题时不易选错。

topics.title: SuperGrok 用量显示到本周
topics.text: 连接 SuperGrok 后，状态区域可以显示每周订阅用量，查看剩余额度时不必再跳到其他页面。

topics.title: 跨设备中断后更容易接上
topics.text: 设备连接短暂中断时会更稳妥地恢复，Codex 任务中的计划也能在重开后继续显示。手机端下载确认框在状态变化时不再跳动，登录与授权恢复流程也更稳定。

topics.title: 创作结果能回到当前任务
topics.text: 从 Creative Studio 选择“在对话中使用”时，登录状态在后台刷新不会再清掉当前任务。图片地址、插件详情和消息跟随也一起修正，媒体结果更少出现找不到归属或显示不完整。

topics.title: iOS Simulator 切换任务后仍可查看
topics.text: 切换任务时，正在使用的 iOS Simulator 会保留查看权限并暂停控制，回到原任务后可以继续。无法使用时也会说明是设备、连接、权限还是当前任务状态造成的。

topics.title: 日常运行中的故障更少
topics.text: 修复了启动白屏、单点登录状态残留、消息滚动跟随、远端 Pi 临时失败、自动审查选错路线和工具反复执行等问题。启动时的数据检查与异常提示也更稳妥，遇到故障时会尽量保留当前任务。

en.intro: Mira 0.1.5 adds image and video model support, optional writing suggestions, and clearer task separation in Feishu groups. It also improves task status, model discovery, remote recovery, and a range of desktop and mobile details. iOS and Android both receive this as an in-app content update. If you already have 0.1.4 installed, there is no reinstall and no new TestFlight build required.

topics.title: Image and video models join the model catalog
topics.text: When a connected service provides xAI image or video models, Mira can now discover and use them, including Grok Imagine Video. Plugin media tools look for available capabilities in the same model catalog. Availability depends on the services and models you have connected.

topics.title: Fill a writing suggestion before sending
topics.text: The composer can show an optional recommendation to help you start from an empty field. It is off by default. When enabled, Tab fills the suggestion into the composer without sending it, so you can keep editing first.

topics.title: Feishu group questions move into separate topics
topics.text: Mentioning Mira in a Feishu group's main chat now opens a topic, and each topic keeps an independent task so unrelated questions do not mix together. If a topic cannot be created, Mira continues in the original group chat instead of interrupting the reply.

topics.title: Clearer task status and sidebar details
topics.text: The sidebar now presents task time, linked pull requests, Tokens, and cost more clearly, while priorities for running tasks stay current. Search, long-title hints, Worker layouts, pull-request status, and review-comment status are also easier to follow.

topics.title: More dependable model discovery and routing
topics.text: Mira more accurately tracks which service supplies a model, which models the active account can see, and how each model should be called. Services such as GLM can now complete their catalog, with fewer wrong choices after account changes, catalog refreshes, or task-title generation.

topics.title: See weekly SuperGrok usage
topics.text: When SuperGrok is connected, the status area can show weekly subscription usage, so you can check what remains without opening another page.

topics.title: Resume more easily after a connection break
topics.text: Device connections recover more safely after brief interruptions, and plans inside Codex tasks remain available after reopening. The mobile download confirmation no longer jumps as state changes, while sign-in and authorization recovery are more stable.

topics.title: Creative results return to the active task
topics.text: Choosing Use in Chat from Creative Studio no longer loses the active task when sign-in renews in the background. Image links, plugin details, and message following have also been corrected, reducing missing ownership and incomplete media displays.

topics.title: Keep viewing iOS Simulator after switching tasks
topics.text: When you switch tasks, an active iOS Simulator remains viewable while control pauses, and control can continue after you return. If it is unavailable, Mira now explains whether the cause is the device, connection, permission, or current task state.

topics.title: Fewer interruptions in everyday use
topics.text: This release fixes startup white screens, stale single sign-on state, message-following errors, transient remote Pi failures, incorrect automatic-review routing, and tools running repeatedly. Startup data checks and failure messages are also safer, with the current task preserved whenever possible.
